install.notes: Nothing to install for the fake backend. A live deployment (never run for this package) is the upstream ROS side as documented: the Docker image of tutorials/pick_and_place/docker/Dockerfile (ros:melodic-ros-base, ros-melodic-moveit and ros-melodic-rosbridge-suite, lines 1 and 5), roslaunch of tutorials/pick_and_place/ROS/src/niryo_moveit/launch/part_3.launch, plus a rosbridge websocket the operator starts and publishes. The RosDriver reaches the planner only through that rosbridge, never through the ROS-TCP endpoint on port 10000.
